description: This file contains a Python class 'AmazonStability3Config' and related functions to configure and interact with Amazon Stability 3 models for image generation, including methods for model configuration, parameter mapping, response transformation, and cost calculation.

classes.name: AmazonStability3Config
classes.description: Configuration class for Amazon Stability 3 models, providing methods to get model settings, verify model versions, transform requests and responses, and calculate costs.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of class variables that are not functions or None, representing configuration parameters.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(cls, model: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Returns an empty list indicating no additional OpenAI parameters are supported for Stability 3 models.

methods.name: bool _is_stability_3_model(cls, model: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Checks if a given model string matches patterns indicating a Stability 3 model.

methods.name: AmazonStability3TextToImageRequest transform_request_body( cls, text: str, optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Transforms input text and optional parameters into an AmazonStability3TextToImageRequest object.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params(cls, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Bedrock parameters; for Stability 3, it returns optional_params directly.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_response_dict_to_openai_response( cls, model_response: ImageResponse, response_dict: dict )
methods.description: Converts a response dictionary into an ImageResponse object and raises an error if finish reasons are found.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( cls, model: str, image_response: ImageResponse, size: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost based on model information, number of images, and optional parameters.
